basis: The dashboard series is the 'Number of COVID-19 patients hospitalized' (r2 O1) plotted against 'Month' from Feb 24, 2020 to Mar 14, 2020 (r2 O2). The y-axis is inverted with 0 at the top and 8000 at the bottom (r2 O3, r1 O2), so the line's downward trajectory toward the right indicates a rising census. The trend is accelerating, with the count rising from near 0 to approximately 8,500 by Mar 14, 2020 (r2 O4, r2 B4). This constitutes rapidly increasing inpatient demand for the current period.
option_label: Route to hospital surge-capacity planning guidance for rapidly increasing COVID-19 inpatient demand
